title: Reconcile slot_claim.py with spec 6.2-6.3 wire model (integer keys, expiry, claim_seq, 305s horizon)
description: Discovered while resolving g8pq: python/src/lichen/gateway/slot_claim.py diverges from spec/08-gateway-coordination.md Section 6.2-6.3 in multiple ways: (1) wire model — spec payload uses INTEGER keys 1-7 (slots, superframe_epoch, mode, expiry, gateway_iid, claim_seq, ordinal); the Python implementation uses TEXT keys (gateway_iid/slots/superframe_id/timestamp/gateway_count/ordinal) pinned by gcp_slot_claim.json format_version 2; (2) spec field 4 is 'expiry' (claim valid until) with receiver steps 7/7a enforcing now < expiry <= now + MAX_CLAIM_DURATION (5 superframes = 300s + 5s clock tolerance = 305s per the 60s superframe) — the Python 'timestamp' field has no upper bound and j6o2's horizon used 5 * 2s (link-channel superframe) = 10s, diverging from the spec's 305s; (3) spec field 6 claim_seq (monotonic, replay gate step 8) is absent from the Python model. Resolution belongs to the 70p7 claim-model rework: reconcile implementation + vectors + spec (or re-spec the text-key model), then re-point the j6o2 horizon check at the spec's expiry field with the 305s tolerance. Discovered-from: g8pq, j6o2, 70p7.
close_reason: STALE-BEAD VERIFIED: all three divergences this bead flagged are resolved at the current tip (the resolution landed via l1qw.16.1 + this session's parity work). (1) WIRE MODEL: encode_claim_canonical now emits the spec wire form with INTEGER keys 1-7 (slots, superframe_epoch, mode, expiry, gateway_iid bstr(8), claim_seq, ordinal) and byte-matches the shared corpus payload_hex (happy_path_n1: a7 01 81 07 02 0c 03 00 04 1a...); the string-keyed to_cbor_map is dropped (grep clean). (2) HORIZON: MAX_CLAIM_DURATION_SECONDS = 5 superframes x 60s + 5s tolerance = 305s, enforced at verify_slot_claim:474 (expiry > now + 305 -> EXPIRY_TOO_FAR) — the 10s interim horizon is gone; the corpus expiry_boundary cases pin it. (3) CLAIM_SEQ: the SlotClaim dataclass has claim_seq (required, :134), decode/encode handle key 6, and SlotClaimReplayCache implements the step-8 replay gate (per-gateway-IID high-water, MAX_GATEWAYS-bounded). The old gcp_slot_claim.json format_version-2 corpus is superseded by gcp_slot_claim_cose_sign1.json (integer-keyed, 13 cases, consumed by python tests 6 passed/3 documented-skips + rust ccp16 vectors 2/2 + C coap_slot_claim 1/1). Verification: test_slot_claim.py 57 passed, test_slot_claim_cose_vectors.py 6 passed.
